replies: Branka levels her warhammer at the rooftops. "After them! Yeva, find us a way up there before they slip off."
Branka hauls herself onto the nearest roof and searches it for any sign of where the hooded figures went.
Branka looks for tracks, a dropped arrow, anything that shows which way they fled, and follows it.
Branka keeps watch down the corridor while Yeva works the lock on the carved door.
Branka follows the draft to the bookcase in the study and feels along the carvings for a catch.
Branka presses on the back of the hidden compartment and feels where the draft comes from, in case a passage runs on.
Branka plants both fists on the table. "You lost that shipment too, didn't you. Who sold you out? Name him."
Branka asks where this man went, and whether anyone has seen him since. "Point us at him and he's ours."
Branka asks whether he has ever met a Valkaran scholar named Joran Antonov. "Harron at the Silver Serpent says you did."
Branka hangs back behind a cart and follows Silverhand's group at a distance, keeping to the shadows.
Branka quickens her pace to catch Silverhand and calls after him. "Silverhand! A word about the scholar Joran."
Branka plants herself in Silverhand's path. "You'll talk to us here, or we follow you all night."
Branka keeps watch at the foot of the stairs while the others search the racks for anything hidden.
Branka tells the sommelier they were sent down to check the stock, and that he should fetch his wine and go.
Branka hauls the odd rack away from the wall and hammers at the vault lock.
Branka tells the guards to take the party to the steward, not parade them before the guests.
Branka steps between the two leaders. "Enough. What exactly did each of you lose? Name it."
Branka asks where the trouble started, and whether anyone saw where the missing goods went.
Branka tells the crowd to go home, then asks the party where they mean to sleep tonight.
